_comment: DEVELOPMENT DEFAULTS ONLY. These produce a locally installable, locally signed MSIX so
the Store packaging path can be built and tested before Partner Center verification
completes and before the app name is reserved.
Nothing here is a real Store value. For a Store build, supply the real values as
environment variables and run `npm run dist:msix:store` -- it refuses to build if these
MSIX_IDENTITY_NAME          Partner Center > Product identity > Package/Identity/Name
MSIX_PUBLISHER              Partner Center > Product identity > Package/Identity/Publisher
MSIX_PUBLISHER_DISPLAY_NAME Partner Center > Product identity > Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName
MSIX_PACKAGE_VERSION        optional; defaults to package.json version + '.0'
Environment variables win over this file, so CI can inject them as secrets without a
checked-in copy of the Store identity.
description: Fuzzywumpets Shipping — desktop app with background label and packing-slip printing.
